bullets.text: CR 95.9 for Q3, matching YTD, achieving a recovery to target underwriting margins after about 65 rate adjustments across product and geographic combinations over the past two quarters.

Auto average premium per policy matched expectations well; annual-period special lines and Commercial Auto are on-track to rate adequacy, though Commercial Auto may require more rate tuning in selected sectors.
Written premium grew 10% in Q3, the strongest growth since Q1 2005, with rate contribution expected to be significantly more than it has been for some time.
New business production lagged prior year by about 5% in Agency and Direct auto and 1% in special lines and Commercial Auto, pressured by positive rate adjustments.
Escalating frequency and severity conditions from Q2 were matched for the time being by pricing adjustments; company remains vigilant to keep pricing trend in line with loss cost trends.

Declared $1.00/share special dividend payable November 29; investment portfolio achieved 6% total return year-to-date; continuous capital strength supported return of capital in excess of expected needs.

Entered non-controlling equity arrangement with parent of American Strategic Insurance (ASI) for agent-distributed Progressive Home Advantage; expanded Direct homeowners panel to seven participating partner companies.

Progressive under-indexes in agent-produced business for established households requiring coordinated multi-product coverage; noted independent agency new business is very elastic, fueled by comparative rating technology.

Flo campaign exceeded 80 commercials and won Madison Avenue Walk of Fame honors; ad spend scaled down somewhat during rate restoration; 2013 priorities highlight Snapshot and pre-purchase test drives.
Isaac was the most notable catastrophe of the first nine months; claims handled volume with high-quality resolution and accuracy in settlement cost, expecting to do the same for Sandy.
